articles.title: Russell says his 'confidence is back and growing'
articles.description: George Russell says he "doesn't feel lost any more" as he seeks to end a difficult season on a high and chase down team-mate Kimi Antonelli's championship lead.

articles.title: Bahrain GP in Malaysia becomes third heat-hazard race of year
articles.description: This weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia is declared a heat-hazard race, the third time the designation has been used this year.

articles.title: Ocon to leave Haas putting F1 future in doubt
articles.description: Esteban Ocon is fighting to save his Formula 1 career after the Haas team announcement that they are splitting with the Frenchman at the end of the year.
